headline: MCA reportedly proposes amendments to the CSR framework; key highlights published
summary_points: Legal 500 reports on proposed amendments to the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) framework in India.
The changes are reported as proposals; no final notification or effective date is confirmed in the material available.
The full text of the proposals and the specific provisions affected are not available, so details need verification.
Companies covered by CSR obligations should track the final notified rules once issued.
who_is_affected: Companies subject to CSR obligations under Section 135 of the Companies Act, along with their CSR committees, implementing agencies and advisers.
action_required: Read the official MCA draft or notification when available, and review CSR policies and budgets once the amendments are finalised.

CSR framework: proposed amendments reported

Legal 500 has published key highlights of proposed amendments to India's CSR framework.

As reported, these are proposals and not yet confirmed as final. The material available to us does not give the specific provisions, the notification number or an effective date.

What this means for finance and compliance teams:

- Companies with CSR obligations should watch for the official MCA draft or notification.
- CSR committees may need to revisit their policies, annual action plans and implementation arrangements once the changes are final.
- Advisers should be ready to brief clients on any changes to eligibility, spending, reporting or implementing agency requirements, if these are covered.

We will update this as soon as the official text is available.

Please verify the details with the official MCA source before acting.
